statusDefinitions.automated: Implemented in the isolated vertical slice and covered by executable evidence.
statusDefinitions.pending_evidence: Required before production cutover but not yet claimed or satisfied.

gates.requirement: V4 source has no dependency on production routes, legacy extraction, React, or runtime processing services, and production has no V4 caller.
Private beta rsync deployment explicitly excludes all V4 executable directories.
Commands, results, events, work units, costs, and provider outputs use explicit v1 schema versions.
An authenticated versioned HTTP boundary creates and reads intakes/results, rejects document-byte proxy uploads, and fails closed across tenants.

The S3-compatible boundary issues short-lived regional direct-upload authorization, hashes an exact staging version, promotes it with create-only intent, checkpoints before cleanup, suppresses duplicate storage, and bounds in-memory reads.
Document bytes transfer directly to an immutable object-store adapter and are committed only after server-side size and SHA-256 verification.
Exact duplicate bytes reuse one content-addressed blob and one single-flight page computation while preserving each logical document.
Page work is durable, leased, ownership-fenced, restartable, and does not repeat completed provider work.
Provider capability is replaceable, model-pinned, and included in the computation fingerprint.
Suspicious provider output atomically queues a fingerprinted selective repair when available and otherwise remains review_required; it is never silently accepted or omitted.
Published versioned extraction results preserve document order and contain one explicit outcome for every source page.
Every provider attempt, including failure, records model, fingerprint, latency, usage, billed cost, and outcome.
Publication emits one versioned extraction.result.ready event only after batch custody commit.

An independently migrated PostgreSQL schema owns tenant-isolated custody references, single-flight page work, fenced leases, provider/cost evidence, append-only audit, result versions, capacity requests, and an idempotent outbox without changing legacy tables.
Workers stream custody-verified blobs into private bounded scratch, reserve free disk, prevent path escape, verify SHA-256 again, and clean allocations after success, failure, or abandonment.

Provider tasks preserve contiguous same-document locality and pinned capabilities, remain bounded by pages/bytes/time, use hierarchical weighted fairness with a bounded small-job lane, and respect provider admission budgets.

Ready events use tenant-scoped durable claims, lease-token fencing, receiver idempotency keys, rotatable keyed signatures or bearer auth, bounded exponential retry, and dead-letter outcomes for permanent rejection.
The planner predicts corpus-sensitive work, returns ETA ranges and exceptions, persists live calibration, and creates fenced idempotent worker-capacity requests inside the remaining upload window.
At 500 PDFs, 10,000 pages, and 2 GB under representative concurrent load, post-custody P95 is at most 60 seconds and P99 at most 120 seconds.
gates.blocker: Production-like object storage, PostgreSQL, workers, provider quotas, and agreed concurrent-load distribution are not yet available.

gates.requirement: The expanded human-adjudicated golden set retains every required legal-critical field and meets the final WER/CER non-inferiority thresholds.
gates.blocker: Final thresholds and the expanded repair/native/difficult-page golden set remain open.

gates.requirement: Every provider counted toward the SLO demonstrates sustained quota, throttling behavior, and outage recovery at the required workload.
gates.blocker: Production Mistral workspace and Google billed project/quota ownership are not yet identified.

gates.requirement: Custody, tenant isolation, short-lived upload authorization, encryption, retention, scratch cleanup, event authorization, and audit controls pass review.
gates.blocker: Production infrastructure and regional/data-retention choices remain open.

gates.requirement: Finite shadow evidence and soak volume pass an explicit go/no-go gate before legacy drain, one-way cutover, and legacy runtime removal.
gates.blocker: Minimum shadow/soak volume and all preceding certification evidence remain open.
